# Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited

<!-- Generated by `make client-docs`. Do not edit inside the markers. -->

Researched 2026-09-29 · status **partial** · Search/document budget exhausted; the primary Tier-1 sources (AHEL statutory Annual Report CSR annexure on apollohospitals.com, BRSR on nseindia.com) were located but consistently blocked (HTTP 403) or timed out on every fetch attempt, so FY2023-24/FY2022-23/FY2021-22 figures could not be pulled from them. One Annual Report PDF (cdn.apollohospitals.com/delhi/.../Annual-Report-2023-24.pdf) was successfully fetched but proved to be for a DIFFERENT, related listed company -- Indraprastha Medical Corporation Limited (IMCL, operator of Indraprastha Apollo Hospital, Delhi) -- and was discarded as wrong-entity, not used for any finding.

Confirmed the correct entity is Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Limited (CIN L85110TN1979PLC008035), the listed Chennai-headquartered healthcare company, not Apollo Tyres (an unrelated tyre manufacturer also named 'Apollo' but with no CSR/healthcare overlap found) and not Indraprastha Medical Corporation Limited (a separate listed Apollo-branded hospital operator whose annual report was mistakenly fetched and discarded). No prior record existed for any 'Apollo' funder in the catalog, so every finding is new. Strongest usable source was an India CSR trade-press article carrying a detailed FY2024-25 CSR statutory table (average net profit, prescribed CSR, actual spend, set-off, unspent) plus programme/metric detail for AHEL's flagship 'Total Health' initiative, SACHi paediatric programme, Apollo SHINE Foundation student screening, Billion Hearts Beating Foundation elder care, and a forward FY2025-26 pediatric earmark to AIMSR Hyderabad. Tier-1 statutory documents (Annual Report CSR annexure, BRSR) for the specifically requested FY2023-24/FY2022-23/FY2021-22 years were identified by URL but were not retrievable within budget (403s from apollohospitals.com, timeouts from nseindia.com), so those years' section 135 figures remain not found.

Website: https://www.apollohospitals.com

## What it set out to find

- Confirm which 'Apollo' entity is intended (Apollo Hospitals Enterprise Ltd vs Apollo Tyres) before researching
- Legal name, funder_type, section_135_bound, identifiers (CIN, domain)
- CSR years FY2023-24, FY2022-23, FY2021-22: section_135_applicable, prescribed_csr, spent_on_projects, total_spent, admin_overheads, impact_assessment_done
- CSR spend by project/aggregate: sector, state, district, implementing agency, amount
- Footprints vs stated priority geography
- Partners (NGO/foundation/hospital/govt) by year, canonical name, kind
- Programs/themes: Total Health/SAHI, cancer screening, cardiac care outreach
- Metrics: beneficiaries, screenings etc with stage/method
- Contacts and documents
